plain_statement: Is there, for the Heawood graph (points 0..6, lines 7..13, point p joined to line 7 + l when p + l is 0, 1 or 3 mod 7), a monotone formula of depth at most 5 for the function true exactly when both ends of some edge are true? A monotone formula: a tree of fan-in-two AND and OR gates over the inputs, no NOT, no constants; depth at most d is said as: the function lies in level d of every family of sets of functions that holds the inputs at level 0, keeps each level in the next, and puts the AND and the OR of two level-k functions in level k + 1. Conjecture.
title: Probe: Search: a monotone fan-in-two AND/OR formula of depth at most 5 for the edge function of the Heawood graph
